name: Run Starlark Script
description: Execute a Starlark (Python-like) script to transform or filter data, replacing a graph of nodes with a single script. The script must define `def main(arguments):` and `return` a JSON-serialisable value (or `stop()` to halt the flow).

script.title: Script
script.description: Starlark script defining `def main(arguments): ...` that returns the result. `arguments` is the input object below.

arguments.title: Arguments
arguments.description: Input object passed to the script as `arguments` (typically wired from previous playbook nodes).

outputs.default: Carries the returned results to the next node (withheld when the script returns stop()).
